title: NHI communication: 'CI wizards are messing with the timeline'

tellings.quote: It was communication with some NHI. It was like, what's going on? Like, why are you here or something? It was like CI wizards are messing with the timeline.
some communication with some NHI was like what's going on like why are you here or something it was like CIA wizards are messing with the timeline right
tellings.difference: The story's quote reads 'CI wizards'; this one reads 'CIA wizards'.
tellings.link_reason: This is the same NHI communication saying wizards are messing with the timeline, told by the same teller.

as_told.title: NHI communication: "CIA wizards are messing with the timeline"

plain: Someone is said to have communicated with a non-human intelligence (the field's term for beings that are not human, often shortened to NHI), asked it why it was here, and been told: "CI wizards are messing with the timeline." A commentator named Matthew Pines relays this on the show from what a person he knows told him, without naming that person here. He tells it twice, and the second time the answer comes out as "CIA wizards are messing with the timeline."
